title: PARACAS RESERVE & BALLESTAS ISLANDS
description: Explore the Paracas National Reserve and the Ballestas Islands, home to penguins, sea lions, and thousands of birds. A natural paradise on the Peruvian coast.
shortItinerary: Day 1: Ballestas Islands - Paracas National Reserve
Day 2: Cañón de los Pérez - Return

itinerary.title: Ballestas Islands - National Reserve
itinerary.description: Boat trip to the Ballestas Islands to observe penguins, sea lions, and bird colonies. In the afternoon we'll visit the Paracas National Reserve with its beaches and wildlife.

itinerary.title: Cañón de los Pérez - Return
itinerary.description: Excursion to Cañón de los Pérez with rock formations and marine fauna. Return to Lima in the afternoon.

recommendations: Bring a sweater or jacket for sea wind
Bring hair protector for salty wind
